sdkPublicApi.note: The SDK models one composition file; the master GSAP timeline is plain document text, not an SDK structural model.

sdkAddElement.note: root data-duration and the master timeline were not regenerated; an added scene has no visibility/time contract

sdkRemoveElement.note: the master timeline still references #scene-4 and the root keeps duration 15

sdkSetSceneStart.setAttributeError: setAttribute on data-start is rejected by the SDK: use typed setTiming
sdkSetSceneStart.note: typed setTiming rewrites the scene data-start attribute and heuristically edits the hand-authored timeline; the resulting visibility entries are inconsistent, so scene timing must go through controlled whole-file regeneration

controlledRewrite.note: whole-file rewrite regenerates data-* scene ranges and the master timeline together

rollback.note: writeEntryAtomic is only called after validateDocument passes; no partial writes

workerRevision.note: revision is recomputed from the declared entry/assets after the atomic write
